# Hello

> The example app: every cubby subsystem on one page.

- Category: examples
- Tags: demo, reference, guestbook, rooms, ai

Hello is an app on Cubby, a shelf of tiny static web apps
served by one PocketBase instance. It is plain HTML/JS/CSS with
hash routing (internal pages live at #/..., not real subpaths). It loads the cubby modules: core, platform, markdown, editor, nav, preview, draw, graph.

Parts of the page may render in the browser, so its HTML can be an empty shell. The markdown snapshot below is what it shows, readable without running JavaScript.

## Links

- [Open the app](https://cubby.pockethost.io/hello/): The example app: every cubby subsystem on one page.
- [Page content as markdown](https://cubby.pockethost.io/_cubby/content/hello): what the page renders, for agents that cannot run JavaScript
- [All apps on this instance](https://cubby.pockethost.io/llms.txt): the site-wide index
